ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious desktop.ini Action
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects unusual processes accessing desktop.ini, which can be leveraged to alter how Explorer displays a folder's content (i.e. renaming files) without changing them on disk.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX("\\\\desktop\\\.ini$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\JetBrains\\\\Toolbox\\\\bin\\\\7z\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\JetBrains\\\\apps\\\\.*")) OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\\\$WINDOWS\\\.\\~BT\\\\NewOS\\\\"))
